These pages have some introductions to a wide range of commonly used statistical analyses in the environmental sciences.

Some simple [hypothesis tests](t-tests.qmd) with the *t* statistic:

* [One sample t tests](t-tests.qmd#one-sample-t-test) - contrasting a single sample parameter to a population parameter  
* [Independent samples](t-tests.qmd#two-sample-t-test) - contrasting the means of two samples
* [Paired t-tests](t-tests.qmd#paired-t-test) - contrasting two groups when data are paired

* [Linear regression](linear-regression.qmd)
* [Analysis of variance: single factor](anova.qmd#single-factor-anova)
* [Analysis of variance: factorial](anova.qmd#factorial-anova)  
* [Understanding interactions](understanding-interactions.qmd)

[Generalised linear models](generalised-linear-models.qmd):

* [Generalised linear models 1](generalised-linear-models.qmd#introduction-and-binary-data): Introduction and binomial data  
* [Generalised linear models 2](generalised-linear-models.qmd#count-data): Count data  

[Mixed models](mixed-effects-models.qmd):

* [Mixed models 1](mixed-effects-models.qmd#linear-mixed-models-with-one-random-effect): Linear mixed models with one random effect  
* [Mixed models 2](mixed-effects-models.qmd#crossed-and-nested-factors): Linear mixed models with several random effects  
* [Mixed models 3](mixed-effects-models.qmd#generalised-mixed-models): Generalised linear mixed models
